newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle active at $116/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle active at $116/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said. Trade was active on Wednesday morning, but slowed at midday as packers assessed inventory.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1325 lbs, few 1350- 1400 lbs, mostly 116.00, few 115.00. ( weighted average 115.78 ).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1225 lbs mostly 116.00, few 115.00. ( weighted average 115.80 ).
Slaughter steers and heifers 1.00 higher on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand good. Seller interest limited early, but good late.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs 72.00-73.00, few 71.75, few in 4 percent shrink area 73.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs 72.00-73.00, few 71.75. Confirmed - 30,800 Last Week - 8,200 Last Year - 20,600 Wk To Date - 44,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 11,400 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 30,700
